Card Q&A.q: Does this card's inherited effect activate when one of my own effects trashes a card from my deck?

Card Q&A.a: No, cards revealed from the top of your deck aren't considered to be “trashed from your deck,” so this card’s inherited effect doesn’t activate.
Card Q&A.q: One of my effects reveals cards from the top of my deck and trashes one or more of them. Does this cause this card’s inherited effect to activate?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When a card is trashed from your deck, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
